findings.title: Weak Password Policy Indicator

evidence.description: Registration page /register contains weak password requirement: at least X characters where X <= 5

raw_data.description: at least X characters where X <= 5

findings.fix: Enforce minimum 12-character passwords with complexity requirements. Show real-time strength meter. Reject common passwords.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint

evidence.description: Endpoint /register accepted 5 rapid failed login attempts without returning 429. Status codes: [201, 201, 201, 201, 201]

findings.fix: Implement rate limiting: max 5 attempts per minute per IP/account. Return 429 with Retry-After header. Use exponential backoff.

findings.title: Missing Secure Flag on Session Cookie

evidence.description: Session cookie 'session' missing Secure flag - transmitted over HTTP

findings.fix: Set Secure flag on all session cookies. Ensure site uses HTTPS only.

findings.title: Missing HttpOnly Flag on Session Cookie

evidence.description: Session cookie 'session' missing HttpOnly flag - accessible via JavaScript

findings.fix: Set HttpOnly flag on all session cookies to prevent XSS theft

findings.title: Missing or Insecure SameSite Attribute
findings.fix: Set SameSite=Strict or SameSite=Lax on session cookies. Use SameSite=None only with Secure for cross-site requests.

findings.title: CORS Reflects Arbitrary Origin with Credentials

evidence.description: Endpoint /api/ reflects attacker origin 'https://evil.com' with credentials

findings.fix: Validate Origin header against whitelist. Don't dynamically reflect Origin header.

findings.title: Missing or Weak Security Headers

evidence.description: Missing headers: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff), Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy. Issues: None

findings.fix: Implement all security headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, CORP
